## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the smallest set of changes that produces it.

## Why

Link the issue or explain the verified problem this addresses.

## Verification

List the exact commands, platforms, and manual checks used. Call out anything
that could not be tested.

## Privacy and security impact

Describe changes to network access, stored data, permissions, telemetry, or
trust boundaries. Write `None` when there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated files.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and limitations are documented honestly.
- [ ] `python build.py` was run when canonical installer payloads changed.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and screenshots contain no private data or secrets.
